name: programming_device_settings
description: A screen's programming source: its group, if any, and whether individual programming is selected.
lifecycle: Created by the first assignment; each assignment, or a move outside the group's span, updates it and bumps the version. Kept with the device record after unlinking.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the screen (tenant key).

columns.Null meaning: The screen belongs to no group and is programmed individually.

columns.Meaning: True when the screen uses its own program although it belongs to a group.
Optimistic concurrency version, starting at 1; the API reports 0 for a screen never assigned.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the last change.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The screen belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, group_id) REFERENCES programming_groups(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The group belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while it has members.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX programming_device_settings_group_idx ON public.programming_device_settings USING btree (company_id, group_id)
